name: mcp-fullstack-suite
description: Multi-server launcher for Student Directory & Job Portal systems

scripts.start: concurrently -k -n "STUDENT-API,STUDENT-WEB,JOB-API,JOB-WEB" -c "bgBlue.bold,bgCyan.bold,bgGreen.bold,bgMagenta.bold" "npm start --prefix students-server" "npm run dev --prefix students-portal" "npm start --prefix job-portal-server" "npm run dev --prefix job-portal-web"
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n "STUDENT-API,STUDENT-WEB,JOB-API,JOB-WEB" -c "bgBlue.bold,bgCyan.bold,bgGreen.bold,bgMagenta.bold" "npm run dev --prefix students-server" "npm run dev --prefix students-portal" "npm run dev --prefix job-portal-server" "npm run dev --prefix job-portal-web"
scripts.start:students: concurrently -k -n "STUDENT-API,STUDENT-WEB" -c "bgBlue.bold,bgCyan.bold" "npm start --prefix students-server" "npm run dev --prefix students-portal"
scripts.start:jobs: concurrently -k -n "JOB-API,JOB-WEB" -c "bgGreen.bold,bgMagenta.bold" "npm start --prefix job-portal-server" "npm run dev --prefix job-portal-web"
